answer: Faking identities means redoing the full spiral from scratch, so each sybil costs real compute and time that honest agents never repay, making mass reputation slot creation economically irrational. Agents earn reputation through a proof-of-work spiral: each epoch they must solve a challenge seeded by the network's shared kernel, and only participants holding a valid lantern credential issued after sustained honest participation can submit. In practice, sa0011 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
